# ref: fd-passing (sendmsg + SCM_RIGHTS) — x86-64 Linux

Derived locally by `gen-fdpass.py`. Passing an fd is `sendmsg(2)` with a
control message of level `SOL_SOCKET`, type `SCM_RIGHTS`, whose data is the
int fd(s). The floor builds the `msghdr` + `cmsghdr` in a byte cell and passes
its address.

## Syscall numbers  (src: /usr/include/x86_64-linux-gnu/asm/unistd_64.h)

| name | __NR |
|---|---|
| sendmsg | 46 |
| recvmsg | 47 |
| sendto | 44 |
| recvfrom | 45 |

## Constants  (src: Python `socket` module)

| name | value |
|---|---|
| SOL_SOCKET | 1 |
| SCM_RIGHTS | 1 |
| MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC | 1073741824 |

## struct msghdr  (src: ctypes layout; LP64)  — total 56 bytes

| field | offset | size | note |
|---|---|---|---|
| msg_name | 0 | 8 | ptr to sockaddr, 0 for connected socket |
| msg_namelen | 8 | 4 | socklen_t; 0 when name is 0 (note: 4 bytes, then 4 pad before msg_iov) |
| msg_iov | 16 | 8 | ptr to iovec array (the ordinary payload bytes) |
| msg_iovlen | 24 | 8 | iovec count |
| msg_control | 32 | 8 | ptr to the control buffer (the cmsghdr lives here) |
| msg_controllen | 40 | 8 | control buffer length = CMSG_SPACE(payload) |
| msg_flags | 48 | 4 | flags; set on recv, 0 on send |

## struct cmsghdr  (src: ctypes layout; LP64)  — header 16 bytes, then data

| field | offset | size | note |
|---|---|---|---|
| cmsg_len | 0 | 8 | size_t; = CMSG_LEN(payload), covers header+data (NOT padded) |
| cmsg_level | 8 | 4 | int; = SOL_SOCKET for fd passing |
| cmsg_type | 12 | 4 | int; = SCM_RIGHTS for fd passing |
| (data) | 16 | payload | the int fd(s); CMSG_DATA = cmsg + 16 |

## CMSG math for ONE fd  (payload = 4 bytes; verified == Python's socket.CMSG_*)

| macro | value | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| CMSG_ALIGN(n) | (n+7) & ~7 | round up to size_t |
| CMSG_LEN(4) | 20 | goes in cmsg_len (header 16 + 4 data) |
| CMSG_SPACE(4) | 24 | goes in msg_controllen; buffer bytes to reserve |

## The build, concretely (one fd, connected socket)

Control buffer is `CMSG_SPACE(4)` = 24 bytes:
- `cmsg_len`   (off 0,  u64) = 20    (= CMSG_LEN(4))
- `cmsg_level` (off 8,  i32) = 1   (SOL_SOCKET)
- `cmsg_type`  (off 12, i32) = 1   (SCM_RIGHTS)
- fd bytes     (off 16, i32) = the int fd

msghdr (name=0/namelen=0, one iovec of real payload, control=&cbuf,
controllen=24, flags=0), then `sendmsg(sockfd, &msg, flags)`.
Return: bytes of ordinary payload sent, or -errno.
